name: orange-studio-man-plush-fashion
image_vibe: Playful premium streetwear, vivid orange studio, hyper-realistic character props
image_purpose: Create a fashion lookbook portrait combining streetwear, collectible character styling, and a pet prop.

prompt.project_info: A hyper-realistic high-detail studio photoshoot featuring the approved adult man from the required face reference.
prompt.main_subject: The approved adult man with exact face, skin tone, hairstyle, proportions, and identity preserved without changes wears trendy minimal Gen-Z streetwear and leans casually on a realistic fluffy life-sized Labubu character. A realistic British Shorthair cat sits nearby with natural posture and detailed fur.
prompt.composition_elements: Full-body or mid-shot composition, subject leaning on the plush character, cat positioned nearby, smooth seamless vibrant-orange background, clear separation between man, character, and cat.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Professional studio lighting with crisp shadows and clean highlights, premium playful fashion-editorial atmosphere, saturated orange monochrome environment.
prompt.technical_specs: Ultra-photorealistic high-detail portrait, realistic skin, streetwear fabric, plush fur, cat fur, and studio surface texture, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a hyper-realistic high-detail studio photoshoot featuring the approved adult man from the required face reference. Preserve his exact facial features, skin tone, hairstyle, proportions, and identity without changing the face or structure. Dress him in stylish trendy minimal modern streetwear. Have him lean casually on a realistic fluffy life-sized Labubu character rendered with soft fur texture and a playful expression, while a realistic British Shorthair cat sits nearby with detailed fur and natural posture. Set the scene against a smooth seamless vibrant-orange studio backdrop with professional lighting, crisp shadows, clean highlights, full-body or mid-shot composition, premium fashion-editorial mood, and no text or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor or teen-coded subject, nudity, altered face, celebrity likeness, malformed plush character, deformed cat, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, text

assets.name: approved adult face reference
assets.usage: Preserve approved adult facial features, skin tone, hairstyle, proportions, and identity.

assets.name: Labubu character and British Shorthair cat
assets.usage: Use only for plush-character scale, fur texture, cat presence, and prop placement; do not add unrelated logos.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: The adult face reference is required. Preserve identity, streetwear, orange studio, Labubu character, cat, lighting, and composition. Equivalent adult identity or prop references may replace non-essential details; no celebrity likeness, added text, or watermark.
